title: Smaller Angle Between Clock Hands
statement:
An analog clock shows hour (1 to 12) and minutes (0 to 59). Return the smaller of the two angles between the hour hand and the minute hand, in degrees.

The hour hand moves smoothly: at 3:30 it is halfway between the 3 and the 4, not on the 3. Answers within 10⁻⁵ of the true angle are accepted.

examples.why: The minute hand is at 180°. The hour hand has moved half an hour past 3: 90 + 15 = 105°, so the gap is 75°. Taking it as exactly 90° would give 90.
Both hands point straight up. 12 is the same position as 0.
The hands are 187.5° apart one way round, so the smaller angle is 360 − 187.5.

hints: Measure each hand's angle clockwise from 12 o'clock. How many degrees does the minute hand move per minute?
The minute hand moves 6° per minute. The hour hand moves 30° per hour and also 0.5° per minute, because it covers 30° in 60 minutes.
Take the absolute difference d of the two angles. The smaller angle is min(d, 360 − d). Remember that hour 12 is position 0.

explain.intuition:
Put both hands on the same scale: degrees clockwise from 12. The minute hand covers 360° in 60 minutes, so it sits at 6 · minutes. The hour hand covers 360° in 12 hours, so 30° per hour, and it keeps creeping between hour marks at 30° per 60 minutes, which is 0.5° per minute.

The difference between the two positions is one of the two angles. The other one goes the long way round, 360 − d. Return the smaller.
pitfalls: Leaving the hour hand on the hour mark. At 3:30 that gives 90 instead of 75.
Returning d directly. It can be more than 180, as at 9:15.
Using integer division for the 0.5° per minute, which drops the half degrees.

solutions.title: Positions in degrees
solutions.idea: Compute both hand angles from 12 o'clock, then take the smaller of the difference and its complement.

solutions.title: Integer half-degrees
solutions.idea: In half-degree units the hour hand is 60h + m and the minute hand 12m. Their gap is |60h − 11m|; everything stays an integer until the final halving.

followups: At what times between 12:00 and 1:00 do the hands overlap, and how often does that happen in 12 hours?
Add a second hand that also moves smoothly. Return the smallest angle between any two of the three hands.
